source: The rune page's stat shards by Riot's perk id, as match-v5 (statPerks) and OP.GG (stat_mod_names) report them: the name coach.yaml's <build> section uses, and the Data Dragon icon at cdn/img/perk-images/StatMods/<icon>. Data Dragon's runesReforged.json carries no shards, so this file names them. Armor and Magic Resist left the page in 2024 and stay for older games.
